subject.title: fix(heartbeat): task prompts reach the model

question: Should every non-empty transcript substitution that is absent from the effective prompt be treated as persistence-only, including heartbeat, bare-reset, and room-event turns?
rationale: The implementation and proof are strong, but this is a generic model-visible prompt compatibility invariant rather than a heartbeat-only special case; repository policy reserves acceptance of that behavioral boundary for the relevant owner.

options.title: Accept the generic invariant
options.body: Merge after current-head checks, using the new tests as the contract for all presently identified non-empty transcript substitutions.

options.title: Narrow to heartbeat only
options.body: Replace the generic rule with an explicit heartbeat-owned signal if maintainers do not want other transcript substitutions governed by the same invariant.

recommendation.title: Accept the generic invariant
recommendation.body: Merge after current-head checks, using the new tests as the contract for all presently identified non-empty transcript substitutions.

likelyOwner.reason: The history ties the current splitter to their work, and they merged the adjacent prompt-boundary implementation that this change extends.
